inputs: TaskSignals describing one task: determinism, risk, reversibility, novelty
An objective, constraints, acceptance criteria and a list of ContextRefs
Observed usage units and an outcome, after a session finishes
invariants: A reference is one non-empty line under 200 characters; a pasted body is a construction error, not a warning.
ExecutionPolicy.allows_subagents is never true, and the bootstrap lock needs two keys - leaving bootstrap mode and a named CEO amendment.
Classification and staleness are pure functions; the clock is read at one store boundary only.
No provider name, model id or paid-API assumption appears anywhere in the package.
A manifest with no acceptance criteria fails validate() (Reference superiority).
outputs: A Classification naming a ReasoningClass and the rule that chose it
A validated ContextManifest with a stable fingerprint and a measurable size
ResourceUsageRecord and ResourceSummary; utilisation and unused-context reports
purpose: Provider-agnostic task classes A-F and the deterministic classifier over them, the context manifest that carries references and never bodies, resource-usage records, and the execution policy that keeps nested agents unreachable.
risks: max_context_refs per reasoning class is a budget chosen by judgment, not a measured ceiling; it constrains count, never the size of what a ref points at.
The classifier evaluates A and B first, then F, E, D - the inverted order is deliberate and easy to break by adding a rule in the obvious place.
title: AI platform
